# KaasuPesu

> A voice agent prototype that chases unpaid bills for small Indian suppliers. The owner speaks a short Tanglish
> note; KaasuPesu reads the bill back, calls the buyer in their own language (simulated), and reports a short
> summary. Node with no dependencies, vanilla JS, pure modules tested in Node.

Before changing code, read CLAUDE.md: it holds the working rules (the Karpathy guidelines), the done-means checks,
the decisions, the open assumptions and the verification log. The spec is the Activity 2 prompt in docs/round1.md.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it is and how to try it in two minutes
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): project memory and rules for coding agents
- [PRD](docs/PRD.md): problem, users and requirements, each with the test that checks it
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): components, the two paths, sequence and state diagrams, data, security, failures
- [Engineering](docs/ENGINEERING.md): how it was built with a coding agent, and how to verify every claim
- [Spec](docs/round1.md): the Round 1 texts; the Activity 2 prompt is the spec

## Code

- [src/flows.js](src/flows.js): the two conversations as pure functions, ownerStep and callStep
- [src/parse.js](src/parse.js): reading amounts, dates, contacts, yes/no and intents
- [src/lines.js](src/lines.js): seed data and every line KaasuPesu says, per language
- [src/ai.js](src/ai.js): OpenAI and Wispr Flow request builders and response readers
- [src/audio.js](src/audio.js): the 16 kHz WAV encoder for Wispr
- [server.js](server.js): local server; holds the keys and forwards the AI routes
- [public/app.js](public/app.js): the screen, the microphone and playback
- [docker-compose.yml](docker-compose.yml): starts the app with one command, `docker compose up`, with no keys
- [Dockerfile](Dockerfile): Node 22 and the app's files; no install step, because there are no dependencies

## Optional

- [test/logic.test.js](test/logic.test.js): the conversation tests; every line quoted in the spec is a fixture
- [test/ai.test.js](test/ai.test.js): request and response tests for OpenAI and Wispr
- [scripts/smoke.js](scripts/smoke.js): the live check of the keyed path (needs keys)
